propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrappers, unlike other store paths which route through gitutil.run_git_write and self-heal transient object-database read faults
The CI failure 'fatal: bad object HEAD' is caused by a merge commit object becoming momentarily unreadable before the bundle operation, not by a corrupt or missing reference
The same transient object-DB fault class is handled by existing retry mechanisms elsewhere in the codebase (gitutil, event_append) but s3_doctor sits outside that self-healing seam
S3DoctorConflict error message incorrectly hints at running 'rebar fsck-recover' for a heads conflict when the actual failure is an object-database read transient
The fix routes s3_doctor._git through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit the per-store advisory lock and transient-read retry, and adds 'bad object' to the transient marker family
